leaderboard_definitions.pass_at_1: mean per-object success fraction over n final attempts
leaderboard_definitions.cost_per_point: inference cost per intended reconstruction divided by mean fidelity on the 0–100 scale
leaderboard_definitions.tokens: total = input + output; cached input is already part of input
leaderboard_definitions.resources: retry-inclusive recorded sums divided by intended reconstruction slots
leaderboard_definitions.optional_criteria: Mean percentage of 51 optional profile checks passed across final reconstructions; bounds retain unassessed checks. Separate from mandatory formal fidelity and completion bonus.

methodology: Scores use the same object/repetition pairs across configurations.

aggregation.pareto_scores: common measured object/repetition slots across configurations, separately per fidelity metric
aggregation.resources: sum available execution measurements including retries, divided by intended reconstruction slots
aggregation.hosted_compute: job-level only; not allocated to configurations
